exit 0
--- stdout
Normalize legacy state.yaml fields: underscore-form role names,
legacy attempted fields, oversized text fields, and raw provider transcript payloads.
If no state-file argument is provided, defaults to the project runtime state.yaml.
Reports whether any changes were made.
Usage:
liza migrate [state-file] [flags]
Flags:
-h, --help help for migrate
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
